summary: Refresh browser sessions from the direct Chrome cookie store before using document.cookie so saved credentials retain HttpOnly account cookies.
reason: Live browser evaluation cannot observe HttpOnly cookies and can otherwise overwrite a working account session with an incomplete cookie header. Keep live extraction only as the fallback when no direct cookie extractor is available.
validated_outcome: Unit tests prove direct extraction wins over live document.cookie, live extraction remains available without a direct extractor, and direct extraction failures are not replaced with a partial live value.
